title: Compare executor weight under the same review panel
body:
Outcome: one controlled comparison of a lighter executor plus the current review panel against a heavier executor plus the same panel, measuring cost per delivered change, escaped defects and operator minutes, with host load, provider and cache controlled by alternating time blocks.
Source: operator RSS intake .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/rss-intake/2026-11-01.md items 1, 3 and 4; related t-q625vvc.
